name: Peninsula Energy Limited
content: Peninsula Energy Limited is an ASX-listed uranium mining company focused on the development and operation of its flagship Lance Projects in Wyoming, USA. As a near-term uranium producer, the company is transitioning the Lance Projects to a low-pH In-Situ Recovery (ISR) operation, which is expected to enhance production efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Peninsula Energy is committed to becoming a sustainable and reliable supplier of uranium to the global nuclear power industry, supporting the transition to carbon-free energy through its strategic asset base and operational expertise.

Officers

Wayne HeiliApril 2017

Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Heili has spent over 30 years in the uranium mining industry. He previously served as President and CEO of Ur-Energy Inc. and held various operations and engineering roles at the Smith Ranch-Highland ISR uranium project.

Rachel ReesFebruary 2022

Chief Financial Officer and Joint Company Secretary

Ms. Rees is a Fellow of the Governance Institute of Australia and a Graduate of the Australian Institute of Company Directors. She has over 25 years of experience in senior executive roles in multinational listed and unlisted companies.

Vice President - US Operations

Mr. Winter has over 30 years of experience in the uranium industry, specifically in ISR operations. He has held senior management positions with Uranium One and Power Resources.

Chief Executive Officer - Strata Energy Inc.

Mr. Knode has over 30 years of experience in the uranium industry, including senior roles at Uranium One and Cameco Corporation.

Mr. Whyte is a Chartered Accountant with over 25 years of experience in the resources sector. He has held various company secretarial and financial management roles.

Mr. Harrison has over 45 years of experience in the financial services, mining, and energy sectors. He was previously a Managing Director at Woodside Energy and has held senior roles at various investment banks.

Company Secretary
